author: Will_29
body: She's not completely immune to any damage, she's just tough. As a Deity I manage to deal some damage to her when I have Deific Channel on and she doesn't.

author: dfoley323
body:
Cockatrice (petrify), VSS (wallop), onyro (wail), ancient dragons

Ideally you want to keep her under stasis, sleep darts, stun darts, stone, so she can never buff, once she gets buffs up, your dmg is gone.

author: Ivaris
body:
She's stupid strong tho. Switch summons with "weak" multiattack-relying damage like buggane, mighty griffon should be enough if you don't have ancient dragon.

Try applying def-- with either onryo summons or the dullahan shield ability, and then loop on deific channel -> Rhada II. It will take longer than it should, but you will kill her.

She's susceptible to all statuses but very resistant to DoT, so it may seem stupid to inflict her, but Rot reduces defense and magic defense as well, and you may wanna bring some consistent rot source to get her defense as low as possible.

author: Ethanlucky7
body: If you got a dullahan skull shield the wail II skill is a nice debuff,  use sleep dart to keep her from buffing, skills with high pen are a must the previous two things are how my ultima went from 0dmg to 2mil

author: Careful-Low-9535
body:
Here's what I've found out that I don't see posted yet:

the bonus from killing oceanus on floor 1 is that you get a buff that will save your life(with 1 hp left) once per battle.

very scary skeleton works on her, without it I wasn't able to do noticeable damage as summoner.  With 1 VSS and 4 ancient dragons I was able to do damage at a rate that I didn't die of old age before she was gone.  But it was slow.  In hindsight I should have added omnistrikes in place of ultima, she isn't immune to any debuffs and I didn't really have time to use a 2-turn spell that does minor damage.

I can confirm that puzzle-makers ambrosia doesn't hurt her.  I didn't see any effect from it at all.  Rather a shame since I had a lot of spares.

sleep affects her, with a fairly high failure rate, but wears off much faster than on normal mobs, most times it prevents her from moving on the turn it was cast, but then it wears off partway through the next turn so she gets to move even though she was asleep at the start of the second turn.  This is useful to interrupt her when she is channeling the power of the gods, by waiting till the third turn to cast sleep right before her cast would have finished.

She drops titan augments.  Ones that I got:

Feet of Mnemosyne: dex 230, Accuracy +10%

Spine: 12% ward

hands: att 30, mag 30, ward 3%, tower shards +4%

arms: mana 80, manaflask power +9%, manaflask charge +7%

she also drops some gear that appears so be worst in slot, drops all stats but gives +1% memory hunting and +3% tower shards.

Also remember to drink liquor or something that will take away your reductions, good luck
